questions.question_text: Arrange integers in descending order: -10, 5, 0, -3, 8, -1.
Explain addition of integers using green (+1) and red (-1) token cancellation method.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Represent positive with green and negative with red. Pair 1 green and 1 red token to form zero-pairs (cancel out). Remaining uncancelled tokens give result sign and magnitude.

questions.question_text:
Case Study: Historical BCE/CE Timeline. Alexander the Great was born in 356 BCE and died in 323 BCE.
(a) How old was Alexander when he died? (2 marks)
(b) How many years after 680 BCE was the year 360 BCE? (3 marks)
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
(a) Age = Birth Year - Death Year = 356 - 323 = 33 years old.
(b) Elapsed years = 680 - 360 = 320 years.

Case Study: Elevator Floor Navigation. A building has 5 basement levels (-5 to -1), ground floor (0), and 20 upper floors (+1 to +20).
(a) A lift starts at floor +12, goes down 15 floors. Which floor does it reach? (2 marks)
(b) From that floor, it goes down 3 more floors, then up 8 floors. Find final floor position. (3 marks)
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
(a) Position = +12 - 15 = -3 (Basement 3).
(b) Move down 3: -3 - 3 = -6 => Wait, if lowest level is -5, let's trace: -3 - 2 = -5, then up 8 = +3 (2nd floor). Algebraically: -3 - 3 + 8 = +2 (2nd floor).

questions.marking_scheme_answer: On a horizontal number line, values decrease moving left. -10 lies further to the left than -2, so -10 < -2.

questions.question_text:
Case Study: Bank Account Transaction Record. A bank account has initial balance Rs 2500 (+2500).
(a) Transactions: Deposit Rs 1200, Withdrawal Rs 1800. Find balance after these 2 transactions. (2 marks)
(b) Next transaction: Withdrawal Rs 2200. Does account go into overdraft (negative balance)? Find new balance. (3 marks)
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
(a) Balance = 2500 + 1200 - 1800 = 3700 - 1800 = Rs 1900.
(b) Balance after 2200 withdrawal = 1900 - 2200 = -Rs 300. Yes, account goes into overdraft of Rs 300.

questions.question_text: Explain Jiuzhang Suanshu historical counting rods representation of positive (red) and negative (black) numbers.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: In ancient Chinese text Jiuzhang Suanshu (9 Chapters on Mathematical Art), red counting rods represented positive quantities/gains, and black counting rods represented negative quantities/debts.

questions.question_text:
Case Study: Submarine and Helicopter Depth Tracking. A submarine navigates at -350 m depth and a helicopter flies at +150 m altitude directly above it.
(a) Find vertical distance between helicopter and submarine. (2 marks)
(b) Submarine ascends 120 m and helicopter descends 50 m. Find new vertical distance. (3 marks)
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
(a) Vertical distance = 150 - (-350) = 150 + 350 = 500 m.
(b) New submarine position = -350 + 120 = -230 m. New helicopter position = 150 - 50 = +100 m. New distance = 100 - (-230) = 330 m.
